observations.text: Own run, argv: flock -o <scratchpad>/dotnet.lock dotnet test Lighthouse.Backend.Tests.csproj --filter 'FullyQualifiedName~WorkItemsModuleBoundariesArchUnitTest|...FlowMetricsInboundApplicationArchUnitTest|...FlowMetricsInboundDomainAndAdaptersArchUnitTest|...ModuleRulesCatchANewOffenderArchUnitTest' at commit 73eb27a8e. Exit 0, Passed 58/58, stderr empty. Both-ways comparison passing on the product means the inline baselines equal the IL edge set (measured, not guessed).

Static review: each rule has a made-up offender asserted by name (ThenTheFailureNamesOnly, Does.Contain offender) with its compliant twin asserted absent (Does.Not.Contain): layer, Domain, Domain inbound, Application inbound, 5 outbound cases (DbSet, data context, API DTO, unlisted Flow metrics ITeamMetricsService, second licence type ILicenseVerifier) plus listed-edge pass, Policies non-handler vs handler, connector vs namesake. Fixture namespaces (Modules.WorkItemsFixtures..., WorkItemsBoundariesFixtures...) do not match the scanned regex ^...Modules\.WorkItems(\.|$). Entry deletion per entry and an invented NoSuchCaller entry are both checked on all five lists; R4 4 entries, no TeamDataService, put-back fails naming it. No nWave tags (grep empty); assertion messages state what/why/how; test uses no host. Reported designer RED: two deliberate breaks, exit 1 with 6 and 5 failures, restored byte for byte (not re-run by me; rule-only slice, product passes by design).

R-W6 deviation judged: the Organisation set-up target regex is ^Services\.(Implementation|Interfaces)$ (whole top-level namespaces), broader than the four named types, so any new edge into those namespaces must be listed: at least as strict as designed. The two extra entries (RefreshLogService->IAppSettingService, WorkItemService->ILighthouseClock) are IL edges the both-ways rule requires. Acceptable. Limit: IL reader misses catch-clause, event and attribute-named-argument references (stated in the remarks).

diagnostic: Accepted. Obligations T1, T2, L1 covered with constructible stimulus, named-offender expectation and falsifier; 58/58 on product.
